description: Build-time Babel plugin (`babel-plugin-react-compiler`, stable 1.0 since October 2025) that inserts automatic memoization.
Purity during render, immutable props and state, Rules of Hooks, no ref reads during render. The compiler relies on them and bails out when it detects violations.
Directive that opts a component or Hook out of compilation.
`compilationMode: 'annotation'` compiles only functions marked with the `'use memo'` directive, for gradual rollout.
Runtime package needed to run compiled output on React 17 and 18. React 19 includes it as `react/compiler-runtime`.
